{{Quotation|game|Home of [[Olaf Olafson]], the seventh Olaf in his family line, this squat, hilltop fort overlooks [[Varajar Fells]]. The grass-covered keep is a haven for [[Norn]] hunters to rest between battles and tell tales by the fireside. Olaf is also the reigning champion of [[The Great Norn Alemoot|Great Norn Alemoot]], and his notoriety draws younger Norn to his fireside to hear stories of his mighty battles.}}

==Getting there==
*Travel west from [[Gunnar's Hold]] or south from [[Sifhalla]].
**The [[primary quest]] [[Northern Allies]] requires you to meet [[Olaf Olafson]] at this outpost.
